headline: Jamf announces new AI Governance control plane for macOS
summary: Jamf is launching a new AI Governance control plane for macOS, aiming to help organizations manage and secure AI tools on Apple devices.
details: Jamf has announced a new AI Governance control plane designed specifically for macOS.
This new offering aims to provide organizations with enhanced capabilities to manage and secure the use of artificial intelligence tools and applications within their Apple device ecosystems.
The control plane will allow IT administrators to set policies, monitor AI usage, and ensure compliance with organizational guidelines and data privacy regulations.
Jamf's move into AI governance reflects the growing adoption of AI technologies in the enterprise and the increasing need for robust management solutions.
caption:
Jamf is launching a new AI Governance control plane for macOS to help organizations manage and secure AI tools on Apple devices.

Jamf has announced a new AI Governance control plane designed specifically for macOS.

This new offering aims to provide organizations with enhanced capabilities to manage and secure the use of artificial intelligence tools and applications within their Apple device ecosystems.

The control plane will allow IT administrators to set policies, monitor AI usage, and ensure compliance with organizational guidelines and data privacy regulations.

Jamf's move into AI governance reflects the growing adoption of AI technologies in the enterprise and the increasing need for robust management solutions.
